City Map Platform Overview

The City Map is the topology layer for all registered capabilities. It records which team owns each capability, what it depends on, and its lifecycle status. The Capability Registry syncs ownership data from the City Map every 15 minutes.

How dependencies are modeled

Each capability is a node. Edges are typed: depends_on for runtime dependencies and registered_in for registry membership. A capability cannot move to Active status while any of its depends_on targets are still in Proposed state.

Ownership rules

  • Every node must declare an owner_team before registration. Registration fails with a missing-owner-team validation error otherwise.
  • Tier 1 capabilities require a named escalation contact and an on-call rotation.
  • Ownership changes must be approved by the platform team (jordan.lee).

SLA tiers

Tier 1 capabilities commit to 99.9% availability or higher. The Capability Registry itself runs at 99.99% because every deploy pipeline queries it.
